description: This Scala source file defines classes and objects related to system metadata management within Spark SQL pipelines, including checkpoint directory handling and flow metadata.

classes.name: SystemMetadata
classes.description: Object containing static methods for checkpoint directory management.

classes.name: FlowSystemMetadata
classes.description: Class representing metadata for a flow, including methods to retrieve checkpoint directories.

methods.name: flowCheckpointsDirOpt
methods.description: Returns an Option[Path] for the checkpoint directory of a flow, based on its destination identifier.

methods.name: tableIdentifierToPathString
methods.description: Converts a TableIdentifier to a path string by joining its name parts.

methods.name: latestCheckpointLocation
methods.description: Returns the URI string of the latest checkpoint directory for a flow.

methods.name: latestCheckpointLocationOpt
methods.description: Returns an Option[String] with the latest checkpoint directory URI, or None if not available.

methods.name: getLatestCheckpointDir
methods.description: Static method to find or create the latest checkpoint directory within a root directory.
